extracted.intended_audience: independent local news publishers, news entrepreneurs, aspiring news founders, and LION members
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptions of LION's training programs, resources, and past cohorts intended to help founders launch, grow, and sustain independent local news businesses. Includes program formats, eligibility, outcomes, and supports (coaching, funding, curricula, peer networks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: A detailed assessment of your news business, with expert recommendations and resources to help enhance your organization’s sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available to any LION member, anytime. Implies an evaluation of current operations and targeted recommendations to improve long-term viability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability 360 (year-long coaching)
rubrics_metrics.description: A year-long program that pairs participants with a strategic coach and consultants who can offer both guidance and tactical support in developing new processes, systems, and documentation to address their top finance and HR needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Piloted in 2024; focuses on developing processes, systems, and documentation specifically for finance and HR. Emphasizes ongoing coaching and tactical implementation support.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Entrepreneur Community (Slack)
rubrics_metrics.description: Join our vibrant Slack community of news publishers and aspiring entrepreneurs to ask questions and participate in conversations about the independent local news industry and what it takes to grow and sustain a news business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community channels include both members-only and open channels. Purpose is peer Q&A, conversation, and informal knowledge-sharing among practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Entrepreneur Academy (NEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: A learning hub with practical training, resources, and case studies to help news publishers navigate common challenges in launching, growing, and sustaining a thriving news business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accessible to LION members only. Emphasizes practical, example-driven learning (case studies) targeted at common startup and growth challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: LION Expert Network
rubrics_metrics.description: The LION Expert Network is a members-only service created to help news leaders connect with, consult with, and hire recommended experts who match their specific needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Function: matchmaking between publishers and vetted consultants/experts for bespoke support (e.g., finance, HR, product).

rubrics_metrics.name: GNI Startups Playbook (founder guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Created by LION and the Google News Initiative, the Playbook demystifies the process of launching a news startup and helps founders build a business that’s operationally resilient, financially viable, and journalistically impactful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive resource broken into six chapters and offering four starter guides on specific post-launch topics. Serves as a step-by-step guide for early-stage decisions and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational resilience, financial viability, journalistic impact (outcomes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Founders should build a business that’s operationally resilient, financially viable, and journalistically impactful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These three outcome dimensions are presented as core goals in the Playbook and underlying LION programming—implying programs and assessments should measure/advise on each dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Weekly tip sheet (newsletter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Weekly tip sheet for news entrepreneurs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribers receive a weekly roundup of opportunities and resources; intended as an ongoing, bite-sized learning and opportunity-discovery channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability Lab: unblocking revenue barriers
rubrics_metrics.description: An eight-week program intended to help independent news organizations identify and address blockers to their revenue goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Developed with the Google News Initiative; participants received asynchronous training, one-on-one coaching, peer learning, and $9,000 in funding. Focused specifically on diagnosing revenue blockers and implementing solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program design: asynchronous training + coaching + peer learning + funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective program components include asynchronous training, one-on-one coaching, peer learning, and direct funding support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple LION programs used this combination (e.g., Sustainability Lab) to accelerate publisher capacity; each component serves complementary roles—content, individualized support, peer exchange, and capital.

rubrics_metrics.name: Startups Labs focus areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Learning, coaching, and funding related to financial and risk management, hiring and personnel management, and revenue growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 2022 GNI Startups Labs offered three eight-week Labs with these explicit topical focuses—implying those are priority competency areas for sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: GNI Startups Lab (2021) structure
rubrics_metrics.description: A six-month program for 10 news businesses featuring assessment, coaching, and financial support to help publishers improve operational and financial sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Longer cohort-based engagement with a small number of participants for deeper, sustained capacity-building and funding support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Startup Boot Camp (idea refinement & launch)
rubrics_metrics.description: An eight-week program to help aspiring entrepreneurs refine and launch their idea for a news startup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides concentrated curriculum and coaching for early-stage validation and launch steps; historically ran 2020–2022 and graduated 59 entrepreneurs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revenue Growth Fellowship (funding readiness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Committed $1 million over two years to 12 LION member organizations ready to design or bolster their revenue strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility and focus: organizations that are positioned to design or strengthen revenue strategies—implies a readiness standard for applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tiny News Collective (launch-stage support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides tools, resources, and training to help founders build sustainable news organizations that reflect and serve their communities. Best suited for aspiring news entrepreneurs in the process of launching their news businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes community-reflective journalism and offers cohort-based supports targeted at launch-stage teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Founder Challenge (self-guided validation)
rubrics_metrics.description: A six-week, self-guided course that sent one email each week with actionable advice from the GNI Startups Playbook and a challenge to complete by the following week.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After completing all six challenges, participants could sign up for a one-on-one consulting session with LION. Designed as a low-barrier validation and mentoring funnel for early ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Oasis (mapping & benchmarking)
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Oasis seeks to map and showcase the growing number of locally focused digital news publications in the U.S. and Canada; the report highlights information about the choices local independent news organizations are making on their paths to sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintains a database (as of June 2025 combined with Global Project Oasis) to serve as a central reference for the independent news ecosystem—useful for benchmarking and research-informed program design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical advice channels (podcast & takeaways)
rubrics_metrics.description: News Guest podcast and published takeaways from labs provide practical, experience-based advice for building stronger, more sustainable news businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These channels are supplementary learning resources that surface lessons, case studies, and actionable tips from program cohorts and practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alumni-reported program benefits (qualitative success signals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Boot camps and labs report benefits such as enlightening instruction, propelling coaching, access to resources, supportive community, validation, confidence, tools, roadmaps, and entrepreneurial thinking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alumni testimonials are presented as qualitative indicators of program impact—useful when evaluating program effectiveness or applicant fit.
